caption: The drawing depicts a brown, leather saddle blanket or saddle cover, laid flat on a plain, beige background. The object is rectangular with an extension at the top left, which appears to be a flap or additional piece of leather. The leather is decorated with intricate embossed designs, including curved lines, leaf shapes, and stylized floral motifs on both sides. The central panel of the object features a diamond-shaped crisscross pattern, bordered by decorative stitching. The edges are also stitched, and the corners are slightly rounded. The coloration is primarily various shades of brown, giving the leather a textured and worn appearance. Near the bottom center of the image, there are two lines of printed or written text: one reads "Arthur E. Reynolds," and beneath it is "HARRY M. WADE LL." The background is plain and unadorned, highlighting the detailed artwork of the leather object.
title: Saddle Cover
